The following modifications are catalogued alphabetically; any listed prerequisite must already be met when you install one, and you may install a modification the same moment you meet its prerequisites.

  • Biochemist's Amplifier (requires 5th level): while using your pack as a tech focus, +1 to tech attack rolls, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Biochemist's Inhibitor (requires 5th level): while using your pack as a tech focus, +1 to your tech save DC, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Chemical Counteragents: choose one damage type that benefits from your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixtures features; you gain resistance to that type while wearing your pack. You may take this modification again for a different damage type each time.
  • Countertoxin: on your turn, you can use your reaction to end the poisoned condition on yourself or an ally within 30 feet, who also gains immunity to being poisoned for 1 minute. Usable twice, with an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Detachable Distribution System: a secondary, detachable distributor can be thrown as a bonus action to a point within 30 feet plus five times your Strength modifier; it works for 1 minute before going inert, and then can't be used again until you recover it as an action. While it's within 100 feet of you, activating your distributor as an action can instead affect every creature within 5 feet of it. Usable twice, with an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Drone Distribution System: your distributor interfaces with the target of your tracker droid interface power; while that droid is within 100 feet of you, activating your distributor as an action can have the droid deliver the mixture using its reaction. Usable twice, with an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Expanded Chemicals: Combustibles (requires 5th level): dealing fire damage with a tech power or class feature can trigger your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixtures features. Additionally, when a creature fails its Dexterity save against your Corrosive Mixture, you may deal fire damage instead, in which case every creature within 5 feet of the target also takes fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. Usable three times, with an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Expanded Chemicals: Cryogenics (requires 5th level): dealing cold damage with a tech power or class feature can trigger your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixtures features. Additionally, when a creature fails its Constitution save against your Noxious Mixture, you may deal cold damage instead, in which case it also gains 1 slowed level until the start of your next turn. Usable three times, with an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Expanded Chemicals: Restorative (requires 5th level): restoring hit points with a tech power or class feature can trigger your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixtures features. Additionally, when your Invigorating Mixture grants temporary hit points to a creature, you may also restore that many hit points to it. Usable three times, with an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Expanded Mixtures: Adhesive: a new mixture option becomes available through your distributor. The target makes a Strength save (with advantage if it's Large or larger) or gains 4 slowed levels until the start of your next turn; as an action on its turn, it can repeat the save, ending the effect on a success.
  • Expanded Mixtures: Blinding: a new mixture option becomes available through your distributor. The target makes a Constitution save or is blinded until the start of your next turn.
  • Expanded Mixtures: Hallucinogenic: a new mixture option becomes available through your distributor. The target makes an Intelligence save or, until the end of your next turn, loses the ability to tell friend from foe, treating every creature it can see as an enemy; each time it takes damage it may repeat the save, ending the effect on a success. While affected, it must choose targets for its own attacks, powers, and abilities at random among visible creatures, and must make an opportunity attack whenever able. This has no effect on droids or constructs.
  • Explosive Distribution System: your distributor gains a volley option; as an action you can affect every creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within 30 feet. Usable twice, with an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Injection Apparatus: a wrist-mounted injector functions as a simple, finesse, light vibroweapon dealing 1d4 kinetic damage; it doesn't occupy your hand slot but can't be used while that hand is full. On a hit, you may also activate your distributor to deploy a mixture, and the target has disadvantage on its save against it.
  • Inoculation: you gain immunity to the poisoned condition and to disease.
  • Integrated EVA Functionality: while wearing your pack, you're protected from hazardous conditions as though wearing an EVA suit.
  • Kolto Aerosol (requires 9th level): a dispersal system releases trace amounts of kolto into the air; creatures spending an entire long rest within 30 feet of you regain all spent Hit Dice rather than half, and are cured of any poisons or diseases afflicting them.
  • Long-Range Distribution System: activating your distributor as an action lets you extend its range to 60 feet. Usable twice, with an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Luminous Gel: as an action you coat an item, object, or location up to 5 feet square with a light-emitting gel that sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for a further 10 feet, lasting 1 hour or until you end it early as a bonus action.
  • Oil Spill: as an action you can cast oil slick without spending tech points and without needing concentration, and the oil persists for the power's full duration. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Persistent Chemicals (requires 7th level): when you use your Biochemist's Touch, you may select one creature it damaged; at the start of each of its turns, it must succeed on a Constitution save or take damage of the triggering type equal to your Intelligence modifier and suffer disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of its next turn — a success instead ends the effect and grants it immunity to it for a day. Usable once per short or long rest.
  • Piercing Gel (requires 11th level and Luminous Gel): your luminous gel's light automatically dispels illusions and detects invisibility, as with truesight.
  • Self-Injection Module: a kolto injector lets you use your reaction and a Hit Die to regain hit points when damaged, so long as that damage wouldn't drop you to 0.
  • Smart Dispersal System: when you activate your distributor, you can choose a number of creatures up to your Intelligence modifier who automatically succeed on their saves against your mixtures.
  • Spray Distribution System: your distributor gains a cone option; as an action you can affect every creature in a 15-foot cone. Usable twice, with an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level, all restored after a short or long rest.
